name: add-fields
description: Add an Action from fields only: Matter, type, status, dates and priority by label and by word.

name: add-quick-add-text
description: Add an Action from quick add text alone: Matter, type, person, priority and a date with a time.

input.text: Ask @Charlie about the corner unit on fri 10:00 #Kitchen /call !2

name: add-text-and-fields
description: Quick add text and fields together: the fields win over the text.

name: add-with-details-checklist-link
description: Details, a checklist and a link to a note, in the body of a new Action.

input.title: Plan the tiling
input.details:
Behind the hob first.
Then the window wall.

name: add-details-with-markers
description: Details with a list in them get the details markers.

name: add-with-web-link
description: A link to a web address at the end of the body.

name: add-waiting-on
description: Waiting on someone: the person is added to the people and the waiting date is today.

name: add-done
description: Added straight into the done status: the completion date is today.

name: add-fallback-type
description: A type that matches nothing: the default type, with a warning.

name: add-fallback-matter
description: A Matter that matches nothing: the Inbox, with a warning.

name: add-fallback-status
description: A status that matches nothing: the backlog status, with a warning.

name: add-fallback-person
description: A person that matches nothing is left out, with a warning; the others are kept.

name: update-status
description: A new status; type and Matter are written as they are.

name: update-priority-set
description: A priority on an Action that had none: a new key after the last mtm- key.

name: update-dates
description: A start date and a timed due date.

name: update-people
description: The people replaced by a new list.

input.details: Before the worktop is ordered, with Charlie on site.

name: update-checklist
description: Checklist items go after the last one.

name: done
description: Mark as done: the done status and today's completion date.

name: reopen
description: Reopen: the backlog status, and the completion date removed.

name: waiting-set
description: Waiting on someone: the person joins the people, the waiting date is today.

name: waiting-changed
description: Waiting on someone else: the waiting date starts again.

name: waiting-removed
description: No longer waiting: the waiting date goes with it.

name: add-matter
description: A new Matter with every field, last in lane order.

input.name: Garden shed
input.outcome: A dry shed for the bikes.

name: add-matter-fallback-sphere
description: A Sphere that matches nothing: no Sphere, with a warning.

name: update-crlf
description: A note with Windows line endings: status and a checklist item, CRLF kept.

name: update-unusual-yaml
description: Comments, quoting, block text and odd values in other keys: only the mtm- keys change.

name: update-byte-order-mark
description: A note that starts with a byte-order mark: properties and checklist changed, the mark kept.

checklist: Check the mark is still there

name: update-only-a-kind
description: A note with only mtm-kind: status, type and Matter are written explicitly.

name: rename-links-on
description: A new title renames the note; links of every kind to it are rewritten (links updated automatically).

description: A closing fence line with a space and a tab after the dashes: the block is edited where it is, never a second one added.
